body.title: Atomic pending-create claim + mutex + fencing + recovery
body.summary: claimCreateIntent 'wx' create-if-absent + claim mutex keyed ISSUE-<hash> via write-authority + guard-directory lock (quarantineDeadGuard) + fence token + heartbeat liveness + ownership checks + verifyRecoveryCandidate reconciliation
acceptanceChecks: integration: two-run race -> 1 create, winner runId, loser claimed:false never mutates; interleaving takeover -> ClaimOwnershipError + fenced; two reconcilers -> one takeover; SIGKILL holder -> quarantine reclaims, 0 new creates, live holder undisturbed; lost execute response -> 'pending' reconciled 0 creates; duplicate/unrelated titles refuse via marker+target; authority-boundary: mutex key ISSUE-<hash> through real withArtifactWriteAuthority handler, PENDING-CREATE-<hash> rejected by ArtifactIds.parse

tests.name: deterministic two-run race — barrier after context assembly, released toward claimCreateIntent; exactly 1 createIssue, claim runId == winner, loser claimed:false never updates/deletes
interleaving takeover race — pause A after ownership read, B takes over under mutex (fence++), resume A -> ClaimOwnershipError, no overwrite/delete, A fenced from later persistence
two simultaneous abandoned-claim reconcilers — mutex serializes, exactly one takeover
crash recovery — SIGKILL holder inside critical section; guard remains; fresh run reclaims via quarantineDeadGuard, recovers original claim, 0 new creates, live holder undisturbed
lost execute response — claim stays 'pending' with owner runId; fresh invocation (nothing injected) reconciles via title+marker, 0 additional creates, persists issueRef + bindings
identity refusal — duplicate titles / single unrelated title match refuse via ISSUE-<hash> marker + target verification, no label mutation, no create

authority boundary — claim mutex acquired with key ISSUE-<hash> through the real withArtifactWriteAuthority/daemon handler; ArtifactIds.parse rejects PENDING-CREATE-<hash>; lock ordering claim-before-artifact-writes
